title: Thermometer

serves.summary: Kindergarten: the child reads a picture thermometer's red liquid as hot, warm or cold by hanging it at the window of its day, moves the liquid to match a pictured day, and picks the warmer of two days by comparing liquid heights.

request.topic: Reading a picture thermometer: hot, warm and cold
request.objective: Read a picture thermometer as hot, warm or cold, and set the thermometer to match a pictured day.

problems.ask: Look at the thermometer. Is it a hot day or a cold day?
problems.goal: The thermometer (liquid low, below the middle line) hung under the snowy window. Every thermometer has a red bulb, so red does not mean hot.
